newsitem.title: FRANCE: French ILO April jobless rate revised to 12.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: French ILO April jobless rate revised to 12.5 pct.

text.p: The French unemployment rate in April, based on International Labour Organisation (ILO) criteria, has been revised to 12.5 percent from 12.8 percent previously, national statistics institute INSEE said on Friday.
The revisions to numbers follow INSEE's annual review of the French labour market, which is carried out in March and serves as the basis for monthly jobless rate calculations for the year following.
The revised figures show the French unemployment rate has climed 0.2 percentage points during the past 12 months.
The revised rate has now been steady at 12.5 percent since September 1996 and was last that high in May 1994.
INSEE said the rate of unemployment among men under 25 in March 1997 had been revised up 1.7 percentage points and for women of the same age it was 0.7 points higher.
However, the rate of unemployment among those aged between 25 and 49 has been revised down 0.6 points and the jobless rate for men 50 and over had also been trimmed 0.6 points.
INSEE said in a statement its revisions were based on a survey of 75,000 households carried out in March but INSEE included a revised estimate for April based on that model.
